title: 5AM PRAYER WARRIORS RECEIVE WHAT 5PM PRAYERS CAN'T TOUCH
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Glory to God. There is a sound in this place tonight. Can you feel it? There is a sound, the sound of the spirit, the sound of power, the sound of breakthrough. I want you to just lift your hands wherever you are right now. Don't wait for anyone. Don't look to your left. Don't look to your right. This is between you and God. Lift your hands. Say, "Father, I'm available." Come on, open your mouth and say it. Father, I'm available tonight. I'm not here as a spectator. I'm here as a participant in the realm of the spirit. Come on, worship him. Just worship him for a moment. Don't rush this. Don't rush this moment. Some of you, God has been waiting for this encounter with you. Heaven has been scheduling this night. Angels have been making arrangements and now you are here. This is not ordinary. This is not a coincidence. You were summoned. Summoned by the spirit of the living God. So worship him, Jehovah Elohim, the one who was, the one who is, the one who is to come, the Alpha, the Omega, the beginning, the end, the first, the last. There is none like you. There is none beside you. You are God and you change not. Worship him. Shalaba. Yes Lord. Yes Lord. We worship you. We magnify you. We lift you higher. Higher than every name. Higher than every situation. Higher than every diagnosis. Higher than every report. Higher than every limitation. You are God. You alone are God. And we bow before you tonight. Come on, somebody shout hallelujah. Hallelujah. I want you to share this message right now. Wherever you're watching from, share it. You don't know who needs this word tonight. You don't know whose life is about to change because you press that share button. God can use you as an instrument to shift someone's destiny. A man in pain right now, a woman crying on her bed, a young person about to give up, share this and become a channel of their miracle. Do it now. Do it in faith. Now before we go further, I want us to worship. I want us to enter into his presence. Not with haste, not with anxiety, but with a consciousness that we are standing on holy ground. Say this with me. Holy Spirit, you are welcome. Come and have your way. I surrender my agenda. I surrender my expectations. Take over this moment. Yes, Lord. Begin to sing with me. You are Yahweh. Yahweh is who you are. You are Yahweh. Yahweh forever. You are. You never change. You remain the same. You are Yahweh is who you are. Come on, lift that song to him. You are Yahweh. Yahweh is who you are. You are Yahweh. Yahweh forever. You are. You never change. You remain the same. You are Yahweh is who you are. Ah, somebody cry Yahweh. Yahweh, the covenant keeping God. Yahweh. The one who remembers his promises. Yahweh. The one who does not forget. Yahweh. When men forget, you remember. Yahweh, when doors close, you open Yahweh. When hope dies, you resurrect Yahweh. Thank you, Father. Thank you, Lord. We worship you. We honor you. There is no one like you. In the heavens, there is no one like you. On the earth, there is no one like you. Under the earth, there is no one like you. You are God, sovereign, supreme, undefeated, unmatched, unlimited. We bow. We bow. We bow. Thank you, Father. [music] Now, sing this with me. Way maker, miracle worker, promisekeeper, light in the darkness. My God, that is who you are. Way maker, miracle worker, promiseke keeper, light in the darkness. My God, that is who you are. Come on, lift your hands and declare it over your life. You are a way maker in my finances. You are a way maker in my health. You are a way maker in my marriage. You are a way maker in my career. You are a way maker. Where there is no way, you make a way. Where there is no road, you create a path. Where there is no door, you open a gate. Way maker. Somebody shout way maker. Hallelujah. Even tonight you are making a way. Even as we worship, you are making a way. Even as we pray, you are making a way. Things are shifting. Situations are turning. Atmospheres are changing. Way maker, miracle worker. You are a miracle worker. You don't need permission from medical science. You don't need approval from economic systems. You don't need validation from human institutions. You are a miracle worker. And tonight, walk miracles in bodies. Walk miracles in families. Walk miracles in destinies. work miracles, promiseke keeper. Every promise you made concerning my life, keep it. Every word you spoke over my destiny, fulfill it. Every covenant you cut with my father's, honor it. You are a promisekeeper. Light in the darkness. Where there is confusion, bring clarity. Where there is depression, bring joy. Where there is despair, bring hope. Light in the darkness. My God, that is who you are. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Thank you, Father. Glory to your name. One more time. Just worship him in your own words. Don't copy anyone. Don't imitate anyone. Let it flow from your spirit. Talk to him. He's listening. He's here. His presence is in this place. Can you feel it? That warmth, that peace, that fire, that's him. That's the Holy Spirit. He's here. So talk to him. Bless his name. Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. Thank you. Thank you. We give you praise. We give you glory. We give you honor. All to you. All to you. All to you. Now, somebody shout a big hallelujah. Hallelujah. Take your seat. Take your seat. But don't lose the atmosphere. Don't let the fire go down. Keep your spirit engaged. Tonight is not ordinary. I knew it from the moment I woke up. There was a weight on my spirit, a burden, a knowing that something is about to happen, something is about to shift, something is about to break. And you are part of it. You are not here by accident. Hear me clearly. This is divine orchestration. Heaven arranged this meeting. Write down the date. Write down the time because you will look back and say that was when everything changed. Hallelujah. Now, I want to share something with you. Something that has been burning in my spirit. Something that I believe will revolutionize your prayer life. Something that will shift the results you get in the place of prayer. Are you ready to receive? Say, "I'm ready." Look at what the Bible says. Mark 1:35. Listen to this. And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, Jesus went out and departed into a solitary place, and there he prayed. Did you hear that? rising up a great while before day. A great while before day. Not when the day had started. Not when the sun had risen. Not when activities had begun. A great while before day. This is Jesus, the son of God, the one who had all power in heaven and earth. Yet, [clears throat] he understood something. He understood the mystery of timing in prayer. He understood that there are things you access at 5:00 a.m. that you cannot touch at 5:00 p.m. Somebody say timing matters. Timing matters. You see, the realm of the spirit operates on principles. And one of the principles is the principle of timing. Not every hour carries the same spiritual weight. Not every moment has the same prophetic significance. There are hours that are loaded. There are hours that are charged. There are hours that are pregnant with destiny and 5:00 a.m. is one of them. Hallelujah. Look at another scripture. Psalm 119 verse 147. I prevented the dawning of the morning and cried. Prevented the dawning. That means he woke up before the morning could fully arrive. He got ahead of the day. He positioned himself before the sun could announce itself. Why? because he understood. Early morning prayer is not just devotion. It is strategy. It is warfare. It is positioning. Listen to me carefully. When you pray at 500 a.m., you are praying before the systems of the world wake up. You are praying before the prince of the air begins to coordinate his activities. You are praying before the gates of wickedness open for the day. You are establishing your authority over the day before the day begins. Somebody shout, "I understand." The Bible says in Proverbs 8:17, "I love them that love me. And those that seek me early shall find me early." Early, not late. Not whenever it's convenient. Not when you've exhausted every other option. Early. Those who seek me early shall find me. There is a dimension of finding God that is reserved for early seekers. There is a level of encounter that is preserved for dawn warriors. There is an intimacy that only the early risers can access. If you've been wondering why your prayers seem to bounce off the ceiling. If you've been wondering why you pray and pray and nothing moves. If you've been wondering why others are testifying and you're still waiting, check the time. Check the hour. Check your watch. When do you pray? Somebody say 5:00 a.m. Now, I'm not saying God doesn't hear prayers at other times. Of course, he does. God is not bound by time. But you and I are operating in a realm where timing matters. And God himself when he wanted to do mighty things, he did them in the morning. Look at this. Exodus 14:4. And it came to pass that in the morning watch, the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians. in the morning watch. That's approximately 3:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. That's when God moved. That's when the enemy was confused. That's when the tables turned for Israel. The morning watch. The same God who troubled Pharaoh's army in the morning watch is here tonight. And he's about to trouble every Egyptian army that has been pursuing your destiny. Somebody shout, "Trouble them, Lord." In that same chapter verse 27, and Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared, and the Egyptians fled against it, and the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea. When the morning appeared, when the morning appeared, the drowning of your enemies is scheduled for the morning. The destruction of opposition is programmed for the early hours. There is something that happens in the spirit realm between 3:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m. Principalities take their positions at night, but they are most vulnerable at dawn because dawn represents a new beginning. Dawn represents resurrection. Dawn represents the victory of light over darkness. When you position yourself in prayer during those hours, you are aligning with the rhythms of heaven. Hallelujah. I hear the Lord saying to somebody here tonight, rise earlier. Get up before the day gets up. Command your morning before morning commands you. Speak to the gates of the day before you enter into it. Somebody say number. I receive that word. Job chapter 38 12 and 13 says, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days, and caused the daypring to know his place, that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, [clears throat] that the wicked might be shaken out of it." Did you hear that? Commanding the morning, causing the daypring to know its place, taking hold of the ends of the earth, shaking the wicked out. This is not poetry. This is not literature. This is spiritual technology. This is prophetic strategy. When you pray at 5:00 a.m., you are commanding your morning. You are dictating to the day. You are setting the agenda before the enemy can set his. You are prophesying into the atmosphere before darkness can release its assignments. Somebody shout, "I'm a 500 a.m. warrior." You see, 5:00 p.m. prayers are good. Evening prayers are needed. But by 5:00 p.m., the day has already been shaped. Decisions have already been made. Meetings have already been held. Agreements have already been signed. The trajectory of the day has already been set. But at 5:00 a.m., the day is still forming. The day is still in the womb of the morning. And you can speak to it. You can mold it. You can shape it. You can determine what it will bring forth. Hallelujah. This is why the devil fights your sleep. This is why you feel so tired at night that you can't wake up early. This is why your alarm doesn't ring. This is why there's always a reason to stay in bed. Because the enemy knows, he knows what happens when believers wake up early. He knows what happens when the saints get ahead of the day. He knows what happens when 5:00 a.m. warriors arise. His plans fail. His strategies collapse. His assignments abought. So he fights your morning. He fights your dawn. He fights your early rising. But tonight, I prophesy over your life. The spirit of slumber is broken. The chains of heaviness are destroyed. From tonight, you will rise with ease. Your eyes will open at the appointed hour. Your spirit will be alert. Your body will cooperate. You will become a 5:00 a.m. warrior. And you will receive what 5:00 p.m. prayers cannot touch. Somebody shout amen. Now, let me show you something powerful. In Genesis chapter 19 verse 27, "And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the Lord." Abraham had a standing place, a place where he met with God, and he went there early. In Genesis chapter 22:3, "And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and claved the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went onto the place of which God had told him." This was the morning he was going to offer Isaac the most important assignment of his life. And he rose up early, not because he was anxious, but because he understood. Early morning is the time for significant acts. Early morning is the time for prophetic obedience. Early morning is the time for destiny defining moments. Jacob Genesis chapter 28 verse 18. And Jacob rose up early in the morning and took the stone that he had put for his pillows and set it up for a pillar and poured oil upon the top of it. He had just encountered God. He had just seen the ladder. He had just received the promise. And what did he do? He rose up early to consecrate the moment, to memorialize the encounter, to seal the covenant. Moses. Exodus 24:4. And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord and rose up early in the morning and builded an altar under the hill and 12 pillars according to the 12 tribes of Israel. Early morning altar building, early morning covenant making, early morning destiny establishing Joshua. Joshua chapter 6 verse [music] 12. And Joshua rose early in the morning and the priest took up the ark of the Lord. This was the day Jericho fell, the day the walls came down, the day the impossible became possible, and Joshua rose early of Samuel. 1st Samuel 15 verse 12. And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Camel, and behold, he set him up a place, and he's gone about and passed on and gone down to Gilgal. The prophetic business of heaven is conducted in the early hours. Mary Magdalene. Mark 16:9. Now when Jesus was risen early, the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils. Jesus rose early and he appeared to who? Mary Magdalene. The one who came early. She came early. She saw early. She came early. She received early. She came early. She testified early. Are you getting this? The pattern is consistent throughout scripture. Early risers received what others missed. Early seekers found what others couldn't locate. Early warriors won what others couldn't touch. Somebody make this declaration. I will be an early riser. I will discipline my flesh. I will train my body. I will wake up while others sleep. I will pray while others play. I will seek while others snore and I will receive what 5:00 p.m. prayers cannot touch. [music] Hallelujah. Now, let me tell you what 5:00 a.m. prayer touches. Number one, 500 a.m. prayer touches the realm of destiny. Your destiny is not negotiated in the afternoon. Your destiny is established in the secret place. And the most potent secret place is the one you create at dawn. At 5:00 a.m. you can speak to your future. You can prophesy your path. You can declare your destination. You can establish your purpose. The enemies of destiny are most active at night. But they are silence at dawn. When you rise before them, you gain the advantage. You set the terms. You dictate the outcomes. Number two, 5:00 a.m. prayer touches the realm of provision. Proverbs chapter 31 [music] verse1 15. She riseth also while it is yet night and giveth meat to her household and a portion to her maidens. Rising while it is yet night. This is the virtuous woman. This is the woman of substance. This is the provider. She rises early and provision follows her. The mana in the wilderness was available in the morning. By noon it was gone. If you didn't rise early, you missed it. Some of you have been missing your mana, not because God didn't send it, but because you didn't rise early enough to collect it. From tonight, you will not miss your provision. Number three, 5:00 a.m. prayer touches the realm of revelation. When the world is silent, God speaks loudest. When there are no distractions, his voice [music] is clearest. At 5:00 a.m. your spirit is most receptive. Your mind is least cluttered. Your heart is most open. It is the prime time for divine downloads. It is the optimal hour for heaven's blueprints. It is the strategic moment for prophetic insight. The visions that change nations come in the night watches. The dreams that shift destinies come in the early hours. The strategies that build empires are released at dawn. If you want revelation, wake up early. Number four, 500 a.m. prayer touches the realm of protection. Psalm 91:5. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, the terrors of the night are neutralized when you are awake and praying. When you pray at 5:00 a.m., you cover your family, you cover your children, you cover your spouse, you cover your business, you cover your ministry, you release angels over your day, you seal every portal of attack, you close every door of um evil entry, you create a hedge of protection that the enemy cannot penetrate. Number five, 5:00 a.m. prayer touches the realm of authority. There is a governmental dimension to early morning prayer. You are not just praying for yourself. You are legislating in the spirit realm. You are issuing decrees that must be obeyed. You are making declarations that cannot [music] be reversed. At 5:00 a.m. you sit in heavenly places with Christ. At 500 a.m. you exercise your scepter. At 500 a.m. you rule in the midst of your enemies. The authority of the believer is most effective in the morning watch. Satan knows this. That's why he fights your mornings. But from tonight, you will fight back. Number six, 5:00 a.m. prayer touches the realm of breakthrough. Walls fall at dawn. Red seas part at morning watch. Closed doors open when the sun rises. Many of you have been praying for breakthrough. And the breakthrough is coming, but it's coming at 5:00 a.m. Is scheduled for the early hours. Is programmed for the morning watch. If you miss the appointment, you miss the breakthrough. But if you show up, heaven will show up. Somebody shout, "I will show up." Number seven, 5:00 a.m. prayer touches the realm of angelic deployment. Angels operate on divine timing. They are dispatched according to heaven's schedule and many angelic missions are launched at dawn. Daniel chapter 6 verse 19. Then the king arose very early in the morning and went in haste onto the den of lions. The king rose early and he found Daniel alive because angels had been at work all night. When you pray at 5:00 a.m., you activate angelic assistance. You release the hosts of heaven. You give angels permission to intervene. You set in motion the supernatural machinery of the kingdom. Number eight 5. Aam prayer touches the realm of healing. Psalm 30:5. Weeping may endure for a night, [music] but joy cometh in the morning. The morning is the time of joy. The morning is the time of recovery. The morning is the time of restoration. Whatever sickness has plagued you through the night will break at dawn. Whatever pain has tormented you in darkness will lift at sunrise. When you pray at 5:00 a.m., you are praying at the gate of healing. You are knocking at the door of wholeness. You are accessing the fountain of health. Somebody receive your healing right now. Number nine, 5 a.m. prayer touches the realm of favor. Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and we look up." When God hears your voice in the morning, he releases favor for the day. He goes ahead of you. He prepares hearts. He opens doors. He creates opportunities. He sets up divine appointments. The favor that comes from 5:00 a.m. prayer is different. Is proactive favor is preemptive favor is preventive favor. It stops problems before they start. It solves issues before they arise. It removes obstacles before you encounter them. Number 10, 5:00 a.m. Prayer touches the realm of spiritual warfare. The night is when witches are most active. The night is when oultists perform their rituals. The night is when covens meet, but the dawn is when their power breaks. When you pray at 5:00 a.m., you are dismantling what they built at midnight. You are reversing what they established at 12:00 a.m. You are scattering what they gathered at 3:00 a.m. Your prayers are done become arrows against the works of darkness. Hallelujah. Now, I want to pray and I want you to pray with me. This is not a time to be casual. This is not a time to be passive. This is a time to engage, a time to decree, a time to declare, a time to possess. Stand to your feet right now. If you can stand, stand. If you're driving, don't stand. But engage your spirit. Lift your hands and let's begin to pray. [music] Father, we thank you for this word. Thank you for the light you have released tonight. Thank you for the revelation that has come now. Turn that revelation into manifestation. Take every word spoken and make it life in our spirits in Jesus' name. [music] Now, I want you to open your mouth and begin to pray. Say, "Father, make me a 5:00 a.m. warrior. Come on, pray it. Train my body. Discipline my flesh. Break the spirit of slumber off my life. Destroy the chains of laziness. Remove the weights of heaviness. Let my eyes open at the appointed hour. Let my spirit be alert. Let my body cooperate. Come on, pray. Hallelujah. Give him a big shout of praise. Come on, celebrate. Thank you, Father. Thank you, Lord. We give you all the glory. We give you all the honor. We give you all the praise for what you have done tonight. For what you are doing, for what you will do. We bless your name. We magnify your name. We lift you higher. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now, before you go, let me say this. Remember what you received tonight. Don't let it slip away. Don't let the enemy steal it. Write down the words. Meditate on the scriptures. And most importantly, start waking up at 5:00 a.m. Start commanding your morning. Start praying before the day begins. This is not a suggestion. This is a prophetic instruction. If you obey, you will receive. If you follow, you will find. 5:00 a.m. Warriors receive what? 5:00 p.m. prayers cannot touch. Go and be a warrior. Go and be a champion. Go and possess your destiny. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you now and forever in Jesus mighty name. Shabakende Rosela. Amen. Somebody shout the final hallelujah. Hallelujah. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in victory. Your life will never remain the same in Jesus name. Amen.
